class Bispecific(iki_plugin_iki__core.models.Complex):
    """Bispecific antibody (acme/protein.Bispecific), schema version 2. An IgG-like bispecific antibody, by its chains and how many copies of each: its two heavy chains, its light chains (one protein twice where both arms share it, as emicizumab's do) and at most one linker. Its chains and copies are its identity, whatever their order (ADR 0138); which light chain pairs with which heavy chain is its arms, a fact of its registry entry, so a mispaired assembly of the same chains is the same molecule's impurity, not another molecule."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/protein.Bispecific'

    complex_ptr = models.OneToOneField(
        iki_plugin_iki__core.models.Complex,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_bispecific'

class Compound(Entity):
    """Compound (acme/protein.Compound), schema version 1."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/protein.Compound'

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255, null=True, db_index=True)
    synonyms = ArrayField(models.CharField(max_length=255), null=True)
    description = models.TextField(null=True)
    stereochemistry = models.TextField(null=True)
    supplier = models.ForeignKey(Entity, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_compound'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('name'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_compound__name__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(name__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_compound__name__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.IsPlainList('synonyms'),
                name='acme__protein_compound__synonyms__plain_list',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllLengthsBetween('synonyms', 1, None),
                name='acme__protein_compound__synonyms__item_length',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.NoneMatch('synonyms', '[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_compound__synonyms__item_one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('description'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_compound__description__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=LessThanOrEqual(Length('description'), 10000),
                name='acme__protein_compound__description__max_length',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(stereochemistry__in=['achiral', 'absolute', 'racemic', 'unknown']),
                name='acme__protein_compound__stereochemistry__values',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            GinIndex(
                fields=['name'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='name_trgm_a82352d5f75bd93d9577',
            ),
            GinIndex(
                SearchVector(Left('description', 100000), config='simple'),
                name='descriptio_fts_f1b87780ad0e0e7',
            ),
        ]

class Lot(Entity):
    """Lot (acme/protein.Lot), schema version 1. A lot of protein, signed for at each step under 21 CFR Part 11."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/protein.Lot'

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    label = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    protein = models.ForeignKey('Protein_Entry', models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    yield_mg = models.FloatField(null=True)
    report = models.ForeignKey(File, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    made_by = models.ForeignKey(User, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    status = StateField(
        states=['open', 'in_review', 'approved', 'released'],
        locking=['approved', 'released'],
        db_default='open',
        db_comment='A state field (ADR 0125): one of open, in_review, approved, released.',
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_lot'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('label'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_lot__label__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(label__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_lot__label__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(yield_mg__gt=float('-inf'), yield_mg__lt=float('inf')),
                name='acme__protein_lot__yield_mg__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(yield_mg__gte=0),
                name='acme__protein_lot__yield_mg__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(status__in=['open', 'in_review', 'approved', 'released']),
                name='acme__protein_lot__status__known',
            ),
        ]

    IKI_ENTRY = True

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,

        related_name='+',
    )
    code = models.CharField(max_length=64, db_index=True)
    label = models.CharField(max_length=200, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_methodcategory__entry'

            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('code'), 1),

            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(code__regex='[\\r\\n]'),

                condition=Q(code__regex='^(?:^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.+-]*$)$'),

                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('label'), 1),

                condition=Q(label__regex='^(?:^\\S(?:.*\\S)?$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_methodcategory__entry__label__pattern',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('description'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_methodcategory__entry__description__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=LessThanOrEqual(Length('description'), 2000),
                name='acme__protein_methodcategory__entry__description__max_length',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(position__gte=1),
                name='acme__protein_methodcategory__entry__position__min',

            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(position__lte=10000),

                fields=['label'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='label_trgm_e4be91afaa12d73bca6',
            ),

class Protein(iki_plugin_acme__dna.models.Sequence):
    """Protein (acme/protein.Protein), schema version 3."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/protein.Protein'

    acme_dna_sequence_ptr = models.OneToOneField(
        iki_plugin_acme__dna.models.Sequence,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    molecular_weight = QuantityField(unit='u', null=True, db_index=True)
    signal_peptide = models.CharField(max_length=70, null=True, db_index=True)
    lims_id = models.CharField(max_length=64, null=True, db_index=True)
    source = models.ForeignKey(Entity, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    encoded_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'acme__dna.DNASequence_Entry',
        models.PROTECT,
        related_name='+',
        null=True,
    )
    temperature_optimum = QuantityField(unit='Cel', null=True)
    uniprot_ids = ArrayField(models.TextField(), null=True)
    summary = models.TextField(null=True)
    pdb_text = models.TextField(null=True)
    host = models.CharField(max_length=200, null=True, db_index=True)
    hydropathy = models.JSONField(null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_protein'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(molecular_weight__gt=float('-inf'), molecular_weight__lt=float('inf')),
                name='acme__protein_protein__molecular_weight__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('signal_peptide'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__signal_peptide__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(signal_peptide__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__signal_peptide__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    signal_peptide__regex='^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYBZXUOJacdefghiklmnpqrstvwybzxuoj*]*$',
                ),
                name='acme__protein_protein__signal_peptide__format',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('lims_id'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__lims_id__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(lims_id__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__lims_id__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    temperature_optimum__gt=float('-inf'),
                    temperature_optimum__lt=float('inf'),
                ),
                name='acme__protein_protein__temperature_optimum__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.IsPlainList('uniprot_ids'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__uniprot_ids__plain_list',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllLengthsBetween('uniprot_ids', 1, None),
                name='acme__protein_protein__uniprot_ids__item_length',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.NoneMatch('uniprot_ids', '[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__uniprot_ids__item_one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllMatch('uniprot_ids', '^(?:^[A-Z0-9]{6,10}$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__uniprot_ids__item_pattern',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('summary'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__summary__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('pdb_text'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__pdb_text__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('host'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__host__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(host__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__host__one_line',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            GinIndex(
                fields=['signal_peptide'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='signal_pep_trgm_1f6762c2ee235b',
            ),
            GinIndex(
                fields=['lims_id'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='lims_id_trgm_8eb1fa52d218dbeb4',

class Protein_Entry(Entity):
    """Registry entries of Protein (acme/protein.Protein), ADR 0115."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/protein.Protein'
    IKI_ENTRY = True

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    sequence = models.TextField()
    residues = models.BigIntegerField(null=True)
    ec_number = models.CharField(max_length=20, null=True)
    chembl_target = models.CharField(max_length=20, null=True, db_index=True)
    hazard = models.TextField(null=True)
    related_entry = models.ForeignKey('Protein_Entry', models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    standard = models.CharField(max_length=20, null=True)
    synonyms = ArrayField(models.CharField(max_length=40), null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_protein__entry'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('sequence'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__sequence__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(sequence__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__sequence__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    sequence__regex='^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYBZXUOJacdefghiklmnpqrstvwybzxuoj*]*$',
                ),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__sequence__format',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(residues__gte=0),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__residues__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('ec_number'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__ec_number__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(ec_number__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__ec_number__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(ec_number__regex='^(?:^[1-7]\\.[0-9-]+\\.[0-9-]+\\.[0-9n-]+$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__ec_number__pattern',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('chembl_target'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__chembl_target__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(chembl_target__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__chembl_target__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(chembl_target__regex='^(?:^CHEMBL[1-9][0-9]*$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__chembl_target__pattern',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(hazard__in=['none', 'bsl1', 'bsl2', 'bsl3']),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__hazard__values',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('standard'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__standard__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(standard__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__standard__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(standard__regex='^(?:^[A-Z0-9-]+$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__standard__pattern',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.IsPlainList('synonyms'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__synonyms__plain_list',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllLengthsBetween('synonyms', 1, None),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__synonyms__item_length',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.NoneMatch('synonyms', '[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__synonyms__item_one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllMatch('synonyms', '^(?:^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_protein__entry__synonyms__item_pattern',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            GinIndex(
                fields=['chembl_target'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='chembl_tar_trgm_5644589f258ec0',
            ),
        ]

    """Registry entries of Purification method (acme/protein.PurificationMethod), ADR 0115."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/protein.PurificationMethod'
    IKI_ENTRY = True

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    code = models.CharField(max_length=64, db_index=True)
    label = models.CharField(max_length=200, db_index=True)
    description = models.TextField(null=True)
    position = models.BigIntegerField(null=True)
    category = models.ForeignKey(
        'MethodCategory_Entry',
        models.PROTECT,
        related_name='+',
        null=True,
    )
    sop = models.TextField(null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('code'), 1),

            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(code__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__code__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(code__regex='^(?:^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.+-]*$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__code__pattern',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('label'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__label__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(label__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__label__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(label__regex='^(?:^\\S(?:.*\\S)?$)$'),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__label__pattern',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('description'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__description__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=LessThanOrEqual(Length('description'), 2000),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__descriptio__5ab3a690f8',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(position__gte=1),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__position__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(position__lte=10000),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__position__max',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('sop'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__sop__not_empty',

            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(sop__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__sop__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(sop__regex='^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[^\\s]+$'),
                name='acme__protein_purificationmethod__entry__sop__format',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            GinIndex(

                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],

                fields=['label'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='label_trgm_f304aaf3807adb25096',

            GinIndex(

                name='descriptio_fts_0bcfd444c4571d8',

class Sample(Entity):
    """Sample (acme/protein.Sample), schema version 1."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/protein.Sample'

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    label = models.CharField(max_length=200, db_index=True)
    protein = models.ForeignKey('Protein_Entry', models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    lot = models.ForeignKey('Lot', models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    material = models.ForeignKey(Entity, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    purity = models.FloatField(null=True)
    concentration = QuantityField(unit='mg/mL', null=True)
    tags = ArrayField(models.CharField(max_length=40), null=True)
    notes = models.TextField(null=True)
    analyst = models.ForeignKey(User, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    reviewer = models.ForeignKey(User, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    received_by = models.ForeignKey(User, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    due_on = models.DateField(null=True)
    status = StateField(
        states=['received', 'in_testing', 'in_review', 'reviewed', 'released'],
        locking=['reviewed', 'released'],
        db_default='received',
        db_comment='A state field (ADR 0125): one of received, in_testing, in_review, reviewed, released.',
    )
    custody = StateField(
        states=['in_lab', 'quarantined', 'disposed'],
        locking=['quarantined'],
        db_default='in_lab',
        db_comment='A state field (ADR 0125): one of in_lab, quarantined, disposed.',
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_sample'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('label'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_sample__label__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(label__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_sample__label__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(purity__gt=float('-inf'), purity__lt=float('inf')),
                name='acme__protein_sample__purity__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(purity__gte=0),
                name='acme__protein_sample__purity__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(purity__lte=100),
                name='acme__protein_sample__purity__max',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(concentration__gt=float('-inf'), concentration__lt=float('inf')),
                name='acme__protein_sample__concentration__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(concentration__gte=0),
                name='acme__protein_sample__concentration__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.IsPlainList('tags'),
                name='acme__protein_sample__tags__plain_list',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllLengthsBetween('tags', 1, None),
                name='acme__protein_sample__tags__item_length',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.NoneMatch('tags', '[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_sample__tags__item_one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('notes'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_sample__notes__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    status__in=['received', 'in_testing', 'in_review', 'reviewed', 'released'],
                ),
                name='acme__protein_sample__status__known',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(custody__in=['in_lab', 'quarantined', 'disposed']),
                name='acme__protein_sample__custody__known',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            GinIndex(
                fields=['label'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='label_trgm_569071a1e789b3a1e52',
            ),
            GinIndex(
                SearchVector(Left('notes', 100000), config='simple'),
                name='notes_fts_a5bf4641b5eb98a678ff',
            ),
        ]


class Sample_History(models.Model):
    """The history of acme__protein_sample: its values at each revision of each entity."""

    IKI_HISTORY_OF = 'Sample'
    APPEND_ONLY = True

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity_id', 'revision')
    entity_id = models.UUIDField()
    revision = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    label = models.TextField(null=True)
    protein = models.UUIDField(db_column='protein_id', null=True)
    lot = models.UUIDField(db_column='lot_id', null=True)
    material = models.UUIDField(db_column='material_id', null=True)
    purity = models.FloatField(null=True)
    concentration = QuantityField(unit='mg/mL', null=True)
    tags = ArrayField(models.TextField(), null=True)
    additions = models.JSONField(null=True)
    notes = models.TextField(null=True)
    analyst = models.UUIDField(db_column='analyst_id', null=True)
    reviewer = models.UUIDField(db_column='reviewer_id', null=True)
    helpers = ArrayField(models.UUIDField(), null=True)
    received_by = models.UUIDField(db_column='received_by_id', null=True)
    due_on = models.DateField(null=True)
    status = models.TextField(null=True)
    custody = models.TextField(null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_sample__history'


class Sample_additions(models.Model):
    """The items of acme/protein.Sample.additions, in order."""

    IKI_LIST_OF = ('Sample', 'additions')

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity', 'position')
    entity = models.ForeignKey('Sample', models.CASCADE, db_column='entity_id', related_name='+')
    position = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    material = models.ForeignKey(Entity, models.PROTECT, related_name='+')
    amount = QuantityField(unit='ug', null=True)
    added_on = models.DateField(null=True)
    note = models.CharField(max_length=200, null=True)
    certificate = models.ForeignKey(File, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_sample__additions'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(amount__gt=float('-inf'), amount__lt=float('inf')),
                name='acme__protein_sample__additions__amount__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(amount__gte=0),
                name='acme__protein_sample__additions__amount__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('note'), 1),
                name='acme__protein_sample__additions__note__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(note__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__protein_sample__additions__note__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(position__lt=20),
                name='acme__protein_sample__additions__position__max_items',
            ),
        ]


class Sample_helpers(models.Model):
    """The items of acme/protein.Sample.helpers, in order."""

    IKI_LIST_OF = ('Sample', 'helpers')

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity', 'position')
    entity = models.ForeignKey('Sample', models.CASCADE, db_column='entity_id', related_name='+')
    position = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    item = models.ForeignKey(User, models.PROTECT, related_name='+')

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__protein_sample__helpers'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(position__lt=5),
                name='acme__protein_sample__helpers__position__max_items',
            ),
        ]
